concepts.name: DX-12 Twelve-Stage Audit Pipeline
concepts.description: Complete audit workflow from beneficiary identification through review, with required outputs, refusal conditions, and reversal paths at every stage

concepts.name: Mandatory Hypothesis Competition (H0-H4)
concepts.description: For any anomaly, register at least five rival hypotheses from ordinary error (H0) through deliberate tampering (H4), each with discriminating observations

concepts.name: E1-E10 Experiment Catalog
concepts.description: Ten experiment types for discriminating hypotheses: holdout, observation-invariance, counterfactual metric, provenance mutation, multi-perspective projection, independent-witness substitution, rare-mode coverage, corrective-input response, red-team separation, fairness/reversal

concepts.name: Twelve-Metric Performance Scorecard
concepts.description: Standardized metrics for EESS self-assessment including observation-sensitivity, independent-witness coverage, provenance completeness, unknown-safe decision rate, rare-mode coverage, reversal latency

concepts.name: Domain Adapter Schema
concepts.description: Machine-parseable YAML format answering eight mandatory questions for deploying EESS in any sector

concepts.name: Five-Service MVP Architecture
concepts.description: Minimum viable EESS deployment: trusted intake, consistency checker, claim ledger, BSSG gate, append-only reporting

concepts.name: Three Product Families
concepts.description: Evidence-Backed AI Outputs, Bounded Agent Operations, Adaptive Integrity Audits

concepts.name: BSSG Five-Conjunct Kernel
concepts.description: contract_match AND effect_type_valid AND target_allowed AND witness_healthy AND evidence_current, three-valued, UNKNOWN never satisfies

concepts.name: Investigation Dossier Format
concepts.description: Six-line top sheet: question, target outcome, system boundary, best finding, competing interpretation, permitted next action
